The [[Shining Blade camp]] is located in [[Dakutu Village]] in [[Talmark Wilderness (War in Kryta)|Talmark Wilderness]]. It acts as the [[Shining Blade]]'s main base of operations during the later portion of the [[Krytan civil war]].

==Dialogue==
*''For all the dialogues associated with the [[War in Kryta]] see [[War in Kryta dialogues|here]].''

==Notes==
* The Shining Blade camp will not appear until the War in Kryta is started.
* The dialogues above do not necessarily occur in sequential order. See War in Kryta for details.
* After finishing [[Mustering a Response]], the camp will continue to appear on the map. However, it will be mostly deserted (there will be a short monologue about this once you enter the deserted camp).

{{Anomaly|If anyone in your party has unlocked [[Lion's Arch Keep]], Salma, Evennia and Bartholos will ''not'' [[spawn]], preventing progress in the War in Kryta content. To fix this, rezone back into Talmark Wilderness without those players. (Normally, spawns follow the player who has made the least progress in the storyline.)}}

==Trivia==
* The Shining Blade Camp was added as part of the [[Feedback:Game updates/20100402|April 2nd, 2010]] update. 
* Most of the [[non-player character|NPCs]] stationed in the camp have made previous appearances throughout ''[[Guild Wars Prophecies]]'' ([[Kryta]], [[Maguuma Jungle]], [[Southern Shiverpeaks]], and [[Ring of Fire Islands]]) and ''[[Guild Wars Eye of the North]]'' ([[Tarnished Coast]]).
